|---|---|---|---|---|
| MinHook | 1.3.3 | BSD-2-Clause (`minhook/LICENSE.txt`) | https://github.com/TsudaKageyu/minhook | inline-хуки функций движка |
| nlohmann/json | 3.11.3 | MIT (`nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT`) | https://github.com/nlohmann/json | чтение и запись `mod-packs.json` и кэша символов |
